name: Kyokuto Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyokuto Securities Co., Ltd. engages in the financial instrument operator business in Japan. The company is involved in the financial instruments business; investment business; real estate business; and research and development business. It also engages in trading, and selling of securities. In addition, the company is involved in consulting services; and offers stock, investment trusts, and bonds. Kyokuto Securities Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
